We have developed a basic version of Hotel Guest Loyalty Management System in Fund 9 as part of Developer training and Project Based Learning Program. 
Main Repository
 https://github.com/Cloud10-Loyality/cloud10Loyality
Documents and UI Screen mockup
 https://github.com/Cloud10-Loyality/cloud10Loyality/tree/master/docs
Source Code

We propose to modify this project and bring it to life up to test with real hotels.
For this purpose, in this milestone, we shall produce following Outputs
Outputs:
・Industry Outreach and Feedback - Our Business Analyst team shall conduct Gap Analysis between what is already developed and what need to be built based on industry needs. For this team will conduct study with 5 hotels. 
・Prepare a Scope document for future milestones. 
・User Interface (UI) Mockups - Revised UI screen mockups for Loyalty Management System
